decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm’s established modular recycling know-how and the reported customer savings signal strong market value that a capable R&D-active firm can further exploit and improve.

As a close extension of the firm’s core mobile processing equipment, it fits existing knowledge, service capabilities and learning routines, and a dedicated product page suggests meaningful commercial commitment.

Although market evidence is still limited, the concept is strongly related to the firm’s existing modular plant competence and the firm’s own R&D and research links raise the chance of refining it rather than withdrawing it quickly.

A mobile trommel screen is close to the firm’s established screening and material-processing domain, so its absorptive capacity, installed support network and growing market position favor retention despite only early-stage website evidence.
